title: Level 2 EV chargers: the makers' breaker tables, terminals and wire statements (Tesla, ChargePoint, Emporia)
attribution: Source: Tesla, ChargePoint and Emporia installation instructions (as linked) — retrieved Nov 2026

makers.model: Gen 3 Wall Connector (PN 1457768-**-*) and Universal Wall Connector

quotes.breaker_60c: For 60°C rated circuit breaker, use minimum 4AWG, 90°C THWN-2-rated copper wire for conductors.
quotes.breaker_75c: For 75°C rated circuit breaker, use minimum 6AWG, 90°C THWN-2-rated copper wire for conductors.
quotes.no_plug: Do NOT install cord-and-plug type connections.
quotes.disconnect: External disconnect switches are neither required nor recommended.
quotes.commissioning: Circuit breaker size is programmed during the commissioning process.

quotes.continuous: The circuit must be rated for 125% of the maximum load.
quotes.terminal: The field-wiring terminal is rated to 105 °C (221 °F) and accepts a maximum of 16 mm2 (6 AWG) wire.
quotes.gfci: If local codes require a GFCI breaker for plug-in installation, ChargePoint recommends a hardwire installation.
quotes.gfci_reason: A GFCI breaker in the panel causes nuisance tripping.
quotes.setting: Home Flex must be set to match the rating of the circuit as determined by the available panel capacity.

quotes.plug_in: NEMA 14-50 plug-in: Requires a dedicated 50A breaker — supports up to 40A charging
quotes.hardwired: Hardwired: Requires a 60A breaker — supports up to 48A charging
quotes.terminal: Wire terminals accommodate up to 6 AWG; 4 AWG will not fit
quotes.copper: copper only, aluminum conductors are not compatible

notes: Tesla's and ChargePoint's tables agree at 16, 24, 32, 40 and 48 A. Emporia's manual 603-00009 Rev D (the earlier source) returns HTTP 404 since 2026-11-17; its help article replaces it.
